Evaluation behavior sets how often the query runs, how long a problem must last before the alert fires, and how long the alert keeps firing after the condition resolves.

In this milestone, stay on the **Set interval** tab. Set the evaluation interval, pending period, and keep firing for.
In the **Evaluation interval** field, enter **1m** (or click the **1m** preset). Don't use the **Use groups (Legacy)** tab.
In the **Pending period** field, enter **1m**. This is how long the condition must stay true before the alert fires.
In the **Keep firing for** field, select **None**. This is how long the alert keeps firing after the condition resolves.
Your evaluation schedule is set. Next, you configure no-data and error handling and choose a contact point.
